comment: Per-chunk gzip-size ceilings in bytes, checked by scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs after `vite build`. A chunk fails the gate when it exceeds its budget by more than slopPercent. Chunk keys are name prefixes ("index" matches index-AbC123.js). Initial ceilings were set ~5% above the first measured build with CodeMirror + Milkdown in place; re-pin deliberately when a feature grows a chunk, so the diff in this file is what reviewers see. Chunks without an entry are reported but never fail. Export (PR after #4): index re-pinned 10.5 -> 11.7 KB for the export dialog and commands; the lazy export chunks (docx, markdownPdf = pdf-lib + renderer, marked) get their own ceilings so a dependency bump that bloats them is caught even though they never load at start-up. Re-pinned index 11.7 -> 14.4 KB (measured 13.4 KB) for three deliberate eager additions since: the IndexedDB file-handle store (recent files reopen the real file), the keep-source-style block merge, and the incremental visual sync. All three run on the editing path, so lazy-loading them would delay the first edit. Re-pinned index 14.4 -> 17.4 KB (measured 16.2 KB) for image paste/drop: the paste/drop handlers and image node view must be present before the first paste, plus the image-title parse fix and new UI strings. The image service itself, the find bar, outline and format toolbar are lazy chunks. Re-pinned index 17.4 -> 19.5 KB (measured 18.2 KB) for tabs and locale support: the tab model, multi-document persistence and the tab bar are on the start-up path (a restored session opens in its tabs). The tab bar is deliberately not lazy: lazy-loading it made Rolldown move ~2.8 KB of shared app code (i18n catalogue, store) into a chunk named after react, which hid it from this budget instead of saving anything. Re-pinned index 19.5 -> 21.5 KB (measured 20.3 KB) for the settled open decisions: tab view state and reordering, text size / wrapping / line-number settings, recent-list editing and heading search in the palette. The sample document itself is a lazy chunk. Re-pinned index 21.5 -> 23.5 KB (measured 22.0 KB) for the bug hunt's data-loss fixes, which must run before any save or tab switch and so can't be lazy: the editor flush registry, the on-disk change check and overwrite confirm, the two-window storage merge and quota warning, and the shortcut guards. Export fixes (footnotes, images, PDF lists) live in the lazy export chunks. Re-pinned index 23.5 -> 24.5 KB (measured 23.5 KB) for the security sweep and in-app help: the visual pane's recovery from documents the parser can't handle, the Load web images setting (checked by every image before it loads), and the Help and reading links. The user guide itself is a lazy chunk. Re-pinned index 24.5 -> 25.5 KB (measured 24.4 KB) for the bug hunt's fourth part and the nesting guard: the lazy-chunk boundary and stale-build toast, Save As onto an open file, and the nesting check, which must run before either editor parses a document and so can't be lazy. Re-pinned index 25.5 -> 27.0 KB (measured 25.9 KB) for the fifth bug hunt's fixes on the start-up path: keeping CRLF line endings and the BOM on open and save, the two-window persistence merge, sanitizing recents, the visual pane's empty-line and failed-state guards, macOS shortcut handling and hints, and the palette's editor-only commands. Re-pinned index 27.0 -> 28.5 KB (measured 26.8 KB) for front matter: the raw-text helpers that skip it (headings, block split, document title), the export setting, and its strings; all run on the start-up or editing path. The text pane's YAML front matter wrapper loads eagerly as its own lang-yaml chunk (5.5 KB), budgeted so a dependency bump that bloats it is caught. Re-pinned index 28.5 -> 32.5 KB (measured 30.1 KB) for the sixth bug hunt's fixes on the start-up and editing path: text encodings (Windows-1252 and UTF-16 read and written back), following tabs and settings stored by another window, keeping edits and view across the start screen, the front matter editing guards in the visual pane, the incremental-sync widening, reference definitions kept in place, and the image and save races. Re-pinned index 32.5 -> 37.0 KB (measured 34.4 KB, up 3.1 KB from 31.3 KB) for Obsidian embeds: the eager parts are the embed node schema and its guarded remark transform, the node-view shells, the text pane decorations, the link style settings and the new strings. The scanner is a small eager module; the attachments service, vault index and config, transclusion, embedRender, mediaRenderers, noteRenderer, embedLinks, embedExport and the banner are lazy chunks outside the index prefix and unbudgeted. Total eager JS (what index.html loads) grew about 7 KB gzip, not 3.1 KB: Rolldown also moved shared code into three small start-up chunks that were outside the index prefix and unbudgeted, embeds (3.0 KB), frontMatter (0.6 KB) and fences (0.2 KB), which now have their own ceilings. The codemirror, milkdown, markdownPdf and docx chunks each grew by under 100 B. Re-pinned after the embeds review fixes (measured gzip bytes): embeds 3,300 -> 4,500 (4,347; the shared codeRegions scanner moved into it), index 37,000 -> 34,500 (33,150; the old ceiling had about 4 KB of slack that hid growth), and new ceilings for the two start-up chunks Rolldown now splits out, i18n 4,800 (4,635) and ui 900 (859). Total eager JS read from index.html is about 472 KB gzip. Re-pinned for Read view as a reader, folder mode and math (measured gzip bytes): index 34,500 -> 39,000 (38,100: the reading controls, focus mode and read keys, the folder navigation history and its toolbar, palette and start-screen entries, saved reading positions, the settings, and the math placeholder step and formula node view, which must be in place before the first parse) and i18n 4,800 -> 5,700 (5,540, about sixty new strings). The reading extras (link clicks, hover cards, folds, callouts, front matter card, diagram placeholders), the folder service and panel, KaTeX and Mermaid are lazy chunks outside the index prefix: the extras arrive a moment after the page is up, Mermaid and its diagram chunks are named diagram- and kept out of the precache.
